name: @axon/electron
description: Axon - 本地优先的 Electron AI 桌面 Agent

scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:preload && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:resources
scripts.package: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac && bun run package:dmg && bun run package:checksums
scripts.test:channels:smoke: bun run build && esbuild scripts/smoke-channels.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/smoke-channels.cjs --external:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/smoke-channels.cjs
scripts.test:chat:smoke: bun run build && esbuild scripts/smoke-chat.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/smoke-chat.cjs --external:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/smoke-chat.cjs
scripts.test:agent:smoke: bun run build && esbuild scripts/smoke-agent.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/smoke-agent.cjs --external:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/smoke-agent.cjs
scripts.test:agent:zima:live: esbuild scripts/smoke-zima-live.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/smoke-zima-live.cjs --external:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/smoke-zima-live.cjs
scripts.test:desktop:smoke: bun run build:main && esbuild scripts/smoke-desktop.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/smoke-desktop.cjs --external:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/smoke-desktop.cjs
